_comment: Impact events for the Signals Lab. Enablement sessions, workshops and launches are overlaid on the traffic timeline so we can see their effect. To add one, append an object with: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, attendees (invited headcount), type, and an optional note. Types: cowork-enablement (our Cowork enablement), enablement, org-learning (broader org learning sessions), demo, launch. Jordan can just message the details and they'll be added here.
